blurb: Port Ship Service provides maritime transportation on the lower and upper Mississippi River with 22 U.S. Coast Guard certified crew boats. They offer 24-hour service at six locations and five substations, including pilot transportation, provision loading, and AIS escort services. Their fleet is equipped with color radar, AIS systems, VHF radios, and certified cranes and forklifts for loading and offloading supplies.
